verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Bitbucket's pull request and code review screens, and a community post confirms repositories can be made public. Nothing in the pack mentions forking or accepting PRs from outside, non-member contributors, so only the PR half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented forking of repositories, a cross-fork pull request workflow for external contributors, permission controls for outside contributors, independent hands-on corroboration.
